perks.name: Stock Exchange
perks.text: Participate in the Stonks Auction for a chance to win Stock of Stonks! Trade them for extravagant items at the Trade Center.

perks.name: Volume Trading
perks.text: The available item quantity per Shen's Auction has been doubled, and two additional Shen's Special auctions will be available if Diaz is Mayor.

perk.name: Blooming Business
perk.text: All Garden Visitors reward Fine Flour and +10% Copper for accepting offers. Invites 5 unique visitors to your Garden and makes higher rarity visitors 20% more likely to show up.
